items.source:
Code copied from Elasticsearch 7.10, Apache License V2 https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/7.10/libs/geo/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/geometry/utils/Geohash.java

Utilities for converting to/from the GeoHash standard The geohash long format is represented as lon/lat (x/y) interleaved with the 4 least significant bits representing the level (1-12) [xyxy...xyxyllll] This differs from a morton encoded value which interleaves lat/lon (y/x). NOTE: this will replace org.elasticsearch.common.geo.GeoHashUtils
items.translation:
从 Elasticsearch 7.10 复制的代码，采用 Apache License V2 许可证 https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/7.10/libs/geo/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/geometry/utils/Geohash.java

用于转换为 GeoHash 标准或从该标准转换的实用工具。GeoHash 长格式表示为经度/纬度（x/y）交错排列，其中 4 个最低有效位代表级别（1-12）[xyxy...xyxyllll]。这与 Morton 编码值不同，后者交错的是纬度/经度（y/x）。注意：此实现将替换 org.elasticsearch.common.geo.GeoHashUtils
